name: Post Sync — publish or edit on each platform

nodes.name: Approved Edit
nodes.notes: The backend calls this only after a human approved the edit. The body carries the post, its targets and the platforms the edit is meant for.

nodes.name: Account Credentials
nodes.notes: The keys for the one account this copy is on. They used to come out of $env, which meant every business on the deployment posted from whichever single shop the environment named.

nodes.name: Post Or Edit On Facebook
nodes.notes: The page's own token, from the account this copy is on. A deployment-wide token posted every business's updates to one page.

nodes.name: Report Back
nodes.notes: Each platform reports its own result, so the dashboard shows exactly which copies went out and which did not.

nodes.name: Sign Shopee Request
nodes.notes: Builds the signed URL. SHOPEE_HOST is the regional or sandbox host.

nodes.name: Update Shopee Listing
nodes.notes: POST /api/v2/product/update_item. Shopee answers 200 with an `error` field set when it refuses, which the next node checks.

nodes.name: Publish To TikTok
nodes.notes: Content Posting API. The app needs video.publish / photo.publish and an audited client, and the media URL's domain must be verified with TikTok.

nodes.name: Read TikTok Result
nodes.notes: TikTok returns a publish_id; the post id arrives later by webhook, so the publish_id is what is stored.
